title: test(plugin-detail): state the desktop viewport in the 15 test files that depend on it (objectui#8444)
body:
Fixes #8444.

Fifteen `packages/plugin-detail` test files now **state** the viewport they assert
against instead of inheriting happy-dom's ambient 1024. No assertion was changed and
nothing outside `__tests__/` was touched.

## The card's numbers were re-measured, and both moved

Everything below is measured on `c03d03bb2` (this branch's base), not carried over from
the card's R46 reading.

| | card (R46) | today (`c03d03bb2`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| test files in the package | 137 | **151** |
| files that depend on the desktop branch | 21 | **27** |
| files that state a viewport | 2 | **16** |
| files that depend on the branch *and* do not state it | (not derived) | **15** |

The 15 in the last row are this PR. ⛔ Neither number is reconciled toward the card's:
the package grew, and twelve of the twenty-seven **already** pin a viewport, so the
card's "only 2 of 137" is stale by an order of magnitude. Lit control on the counting
instrument: 151 of 151 test files match `describe(`, so a zero from that grep would be
a reading rather than a dead query.

The card's other premise holds, re-measured today: happy-dom reports `innerWidth`
**1024** and `useIsMobile()` returns **false** — every unpinned file here runs the
desktop branch.

## Arm 1 — the card's own ablation, before and after

`MOBILE_BREAKPOINT` 768 -> 999999 in `packages/components/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx`,
then `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`. On-disk mutation proven by
`git hash-object` against `git rev-parse HEAD:PATH`
(`97358b5e… -> 7769615c…`); restored **by state** — `git diff HEAD` empty for that path
**and** the hash back to the HEAD blob — never by an exit code; `trap … EXIT INT TERM`
with absolute paths.

```
unmutated (negative control)   Test Files  151 passed (151)          Tests  1372 passed (1372)
mutated, BEFORE this PR        Test Files   27 failed | 124 passed   Tests   112 failed | 1260 passed
mutated, AFTER this PR         Test Files   27 failed | 124 passed   Tests   112 failed | 1260 passed
```

The after-run is byte-identical, and the failing set is **the same 27 files** (diff
empty). ⚠️ That is the **correct** result for this change, not a failure of it: the
mutation moves the breakpoint above every finite pin, so it defeats a pinned `1280`
exactly as it defeats an unpinned `1024` — the card says so itself about
`DetailSection.emptinessAuthority-8376.test.tsx`, which pins 1280 and still fails 2
under it. This mutation measures *"depends on the desktop branch"*; it structurally
cannot measure *"states a viewport"*, which is what this PR changes.

## Arm 2 — the ablation that does answer the question

So the acceptance evidence is a second ablation that moves the **ambient default** and
leaves `MOBILE_BREAKPOINT` alone: append a mobile `innerWidth` of 375 to
`vitest.setup.dom-light.tsx`, which every one of these files runs under. A file that
states its viewport overrides it; a file that inherits one does not.

Positive control first, because a green from a mutation that never arrived is the
failure mode here: a throwaway probe under the mutated setup reads
`{ innerWidth: 375, isMobile: true }`, so the ambient move does reach the tests.

```
leg A — ambient 375, this branch          Test Files  151 passed (151)        Tests  1372 passed (1372)
leg B — ambient 375, these 15 reverted    Test Files   15 failed | 136 passed  Tests   53 failed | 1319 passed
```

Leg B reverts exactly this PR's fifteen files to `c03d03bb2` (each revert verified by
hash against the `$BASE` blob and asserted different from the `HEAD` blob), and the
fifteen files that redden are **exactly** the fifteen this PR pins — the two lists diff
empty. Both legs restored by state: `git diff HEAD` empty across the whole tree and the
setup file's hash back to its HEAD blob.

That is the reverse-verification: the pins, and only the pins, are what hold leg A green.

## Each file was judged, not stamped

No file here means the mobile branch, and none is branch-independent as a whole.

- **Fourteen `RelatedList.*` files.** `RelatedList` reads `useIsMobile` and renders a
  `type="table"` list two different ways: a real `data-table` above the breakpoint, an
  `object-gallery` card layout below it — no headers, no cells, no sort. Every one of
  these files reads the table: rendered headers, rendered cells, the sort the captured
  table schema carries, row actions, the pager, the derived column set.
- **`declaredActionIds.twoRenderers-7182.test.tsx`.** Both surfaces draw through
  `action-bar`, which below the breakpoint collapses all but `mobileMaxVisible ?? 1`
  buttons into a `More actions` overflow. Measured on the mobile branch, its header
  control reads `['Convert Lead', 'More actions']` and the cross-surface equality
  precondition in its first case fails — the comparison the file is built on only holds
  while both toolbars are flat.
- **Two files carry a second `describe` that the branch does not reach** —
  `RelatedList.sortabilitySignal` (surface 2) and `RelatedList.unmaterializedSort`
  (the `data-list` describe). Both exercise `type='list'`, and the mobile carve-out
  applies to `grid`/`table` only. The file-level pin **states** their branch without
  changing it, and both docblocks say exactly that rather than implying the whole file
  depends on it.

## No shared helper — deliberately

The card floated "a single shared `pinViewport` helper" as a shape for a triager. The
ruling's binding constraint is the other one: follow objectui#8399's spelling, ⛔ do not
invent a second way of declaring a viewport. All sixteen files in this package that
already pin one use an in-file `beforeAll` (or `beforeEach`) doing
`Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { configurable: true, value: 1280 })`, so a
shared module would **be** the second way, with sixteen files left on the first. The
suggestion is resolved against the constraint; ⛔ this is not an open question.

## Gates

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` does not exist in this repo, so the family is derived by
hand from the changed-file surface — fifteen `*.test.tsx` under
`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/` plus one `.changeset/*.md`.

| gate | exit | note |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` | 0 | `151 passed (151)` / `1372 passed (1372)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` | 0 | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` shows 105 files under `src/__tests__/`, the edited ones among them, so the tests are covered rather than assumed |
| `eslint .` in `packages/plugin-detail` | 0 | 205 files, **0 errors**, 963 warnings — all pre-existing `no-explicit-any`; **0** messages land on a line this PR adds |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | red before the changeset, green after |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` | 0 | |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | 0 | 6972 tracked text files |
| `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs` | 0 | these files carry `vi.mock` call sites |
| `node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` | 0 | same reason |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` | 0 | this PR adds block comments; the 1-file/1517-byte residue is the ceiling objectui#7882 holds open, unchanged |

`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build` was run
first (exit 0) — before it, `type-check` failed only on unbuilt `dist/*.d.ts`.

**Narrowing declared.** `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint` across every package; this run is
one package. Universe read from eslint's own resolution, not guessed — `eslint .` is
verbatim the package's own `lint` script, and the 205-file count is read from
`--format json`. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no
`project`, `projectService` or `parserOptions` project wiring), so verdicts are per-file
and a diff confined to fifteen files plus a new changeset cannot move any untouched
file's result. The remaining `check:*` farm belongs to CI.

`node scripts/check-unreferenced-sources.mjs` is **not** in the family: it guards every
*non-test* source file, and this diff is entirely tests.

Not a governed surface — `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`,
`CLAUDE.md` are untouched.

## Changeset

Empty frontmatter, the explicit "this releases nothing" declaration. These files live
under `packages/plugin-detail/src/`, which the gate guards for every package in the
`fixed` group, so the declaration is owed even though it is test-only.

## Scope

⛔ No detector was built. The triage ruling put that in a separate `domain:devx` card
starting from this card's ablation procedure, and explicitly not with the taker of this
one. One PR, not fifteen. Nothing else in these tests was touched — every hunk is an
addition of a docblock, a `beforeAll`, and `beforeAll` on the existing `vitest` import.
